thrive-capital._readme: Durable identity corrections (COLLECTION.md §8), written at kickoff 2026-09-03 before the first build: Form D issuers file under legal names the job board renders differently, and the build's name-key join cannot see the alias. Canonical = the firm's own rendering on jobs.thrivecap.com. Re-check that ledger verdicts still attach after any change here.

merges.reason: Mulberry Health Inc. is Oscar Health's legal name (Form D issuer; the IPO Form 3s are filed on Oscar Health, Inc.)
Degree, Inc. is Lattice's legal name (Grimshaw/Hankes Director seats on its Form Ds; Forbes 2017-07-31 Series A)
Browser Co of New York Inc. is The Browser Company's legal name (Josh Miller's Form D seat)

Harry's, Inc. renamed itself Mammoth Brands in 2025; its Form D filer CIK 1556308 filed as ADKM, Inc. (2012-2014, the pre-launch entity: Kushner Director on the 2012q3 $2.25M seed filing), then HF Global, Inc. (2014-2015), then Harry's, Inc. (2017) — scratch/issuer-evidence.json name history; the board lists the new name and the ADV 'Thrive Capital Partners Harry's, LLC' vehicle carries the old one. Applies at the scheduled rebuild; judged as one company in the grind.

Omakase, Inc. is Maple's filing name (Gaybrick as Executive Officer, the $22M Series A on the 2015q1 filing)
